jobs.title: Sr. Backend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Examplecorp builds scheduling software for clinics. We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to design and run the services behind our booking platform.

What you will do

  • Design and build APIs in Node.js and TypeScript
  • Model data in PostgreSQL and keep queries fast
  • Run services on Kubernetes with Docker and Terraform
  • Review code and mentor other engineers

What we expect

  • Five years of backend experience
  • Comfort with distributed systems and on-call work
  • Clear written communication

Salary: €85,000 - €105,000 per year. Hybrid: two days a week in our Berlin office. Apply on our careers page.

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Lead our data team. You will own pipelines built with Python, Airflow, Spark and dbt that land in Snowflake, set standards for testing data, and grow a team of four engineers. We care about lineage you can explain and dashboards nobody has to apologise for.

Fully remote.
